articles.title: How Toronto's new revenue ideas could hit your wallet
articles.summary: The spectre of a difficult budget is looming at Toronto city hall. As CBC’s Isaac Callan explains, city staff are suggesting new ways to raise cash.

articles.title: Mississauga council adjusting committee structure for new term
articles.summary: Mississauga councillors have voted to make multiple adjustments to the committee structure, which the mayor says is part of an effort to modernize how council functions.

articles.title: Community outrage sparks judicial review of Mississauga cannabis store licence
articles.summary: The City of Mississauga is seeking a judicial review of the province's decision to grant a retail licence to a cannabis store in Meadowvale Village, following backlash from residents who say they weren't consulted about it.

articles.title: Macy’s announces Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Macy’s announces Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather.

articles.title: 18-year-old cyclist dead after being struck, trapped under school bus in downtown Toronto
articles.summary: A man, 18, has died after being hit by a school bus and getting trapped underneath it in downtown Toronto early Wednesday, first responders say.

articles.title: Brampton man, 29, charged in extortion investigation
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police have made an arrest in connection with an extortion investigation. According to detectives, a victim – whose identity is being withheld – began receiving demands for money in April, under threats of violence towards their family, home, business and personal property. articles.title: Cyclist, 18, dead after being struck by school bus in downtown Toronto
articles.summary: An 18-year-old male cyclist has died after he was struck by a school bus in downtown Toronto on Wednesday morning. Emergency crews responded to the intersection of University Avenue and Dundas Street around 9:30 a.m. for a collision between a mini school bus and a cyclist. articles.title: Joly ‘convinced’ Ottawa can find a path forward with Stellantis as talks continue
articles.summary: TORONTO — Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says she's "convinced" the federal government and Stellantis can find a path forward amid fallout from the automaker's deal to sell its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant to defence contractor Roshel.

articles.title: Port Credit’s waterfront mega-development reaches new milestone
articles.summary: Construction on a new neighbourhood in Mississauga’s waterfront — decades in the making — is about a third done, with no completion date set yet. CBC’s Jayden Dill breaks down the transformation of the land, and the developer's plans for the future.

articles.title: Stellantis taking Unifor to court over alleged obstruction of environmental assessment
articles.summary: The ongoing dispute over the sale of Stellantis's Brampton, Ont., assembly plant is heading to court, as the automaker has filed a lawsuit alleging Unifor is impeding an environmental assessment necessary to the transaction.
